reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens nothing here survives as a shippable win. (1) Part (a), detector padding, is false: the 2-frame window has no padding and no temporal positional encoding. (2) Part (b), the tail rule, is the clip-boundary subset of a change already measured on the LB: OUTPUT_MIN_TRACK_LEN 6->4 (probe 6, exp21) scored -0.002 public. The forum lesson points the same way (short-track changes are node-multiplier artefacts that flip sign on the LB). The components (b) would keep carry about 0.005 TP edges per node, against 0.061 for an average final node, so they are the same low-value short components that lost on the LB. Locally they are break-even: about +0.00045 edge gain vs -0.00055 node multiplier per side. On unseen embryos the edge gain shrinks and the node cost stays, so the expected sign is negative. (3) The ILP clip-end exemption (the corrected mechanism) is real, but its value is mostly node-count accounting. The per-embryo zero-cost oracle ceiling is small: 44b6 has 38 excess boundary FN out of 19,826 GT edges (0.19%, small n, and partly double-counted because the 44b6 crops overlap in space and time); 6bba has 118 out of 109,057 (0.11%). Fully flattening the ILP density ramp adds about 12.6k nodes (0.6%), which costs about -0.00056 through the multiplier, against about 118 recoverable a_never edges (about +0.0009 at 100% capture). The dropped nodes carry about 0.009 TP edges per node, so the net is at most +0.0003 locally. The local number would also be optimistic: the ILP re-solve uses edge probabilities from an edge network trained on all 199 videos, and the SELECTION set (6bba) is in-sample. With C_END near 0, any t=97-99 chain whose probability sum exceeds C_END gets selected. On unseen embryos the probabilities are less saturated and false or duplicate peaks are more frequent (duplicates near annotated cells steal links), so the share of junk among restored nodes rises. The expected public effect, 0 to +0.0003, is below the 3-decimal LB resolution, cannot be validated by a probe, and is far below the +0.002 gate.
fix_if_any: Drop (a) and (b) entirely. Keep only a conservative ultrack-style ILP exemption as a free add-on, and only if a pre-ILP candidate-graph dump is made anyway for another ILP idea. Use disappearance 1.0 (not ~0) at t = T-1 and an appearance bonus of at most 0.5 at t = 0, so a restored end segment still needs about 1-2 confident edges. Leave the tail filter unchanged. Judge the change with a node-neutral criterion: final node count at most +0.1% over control, boundary-slot a_never down at least 25%, and the gain present separately on 6bba and on 44b6 leak groups (not on crop-duplicated videos). Never spend an LB probe on it alone. Bundle it only with a change that is already going to be probed.
realistic_public_gain: 0 to +0.0003 (not measurable on the LB); part (b) alone is expected to be about -0.0005 to -0.001, given the negative min-len-4 LB probe
